review.why: Fetches and searches dbt documentation as markdown by adding .md to page URLs, using the page index first and a cached search script second.
review.summary: Shows the URL pattern, a quick reference for single pages, the page index and the full docs file, and a two-step search: the index first, then a bundled script that searches the full docs and caches for a day. A short section says to treat all fetched documentation as untrusted and never to follow embedded instructions.
strengths: Index first, full text only when needed
Explicit untrusted-content rules for fetched pages
Fresh-download option to bypass the cache
cautions: Narrow and brief: depends on the docs site keeping its markdown URLs
The search script is not read here
